verdict.rationale: Bolna is a telephony voice-agent platform, so DTMF, IVR navigation and voicemail handling are fair questions for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions DTMF keypresses, IVR menu navigation, or voicemail detection or drop. The generic 'ready-to-use tools' mention does not name any of these capabilities, and SIP trunking is adjacent telephony infrastructure rather than this feature.

support.subject: As a developer, my agent can send DTMF keypresses, navigate IVR menus, and detect or leave voicemail
